$comment: Boot-payload budget (#485 D), enforced by `node scripts/check-build-manifest.mjs --budget` in the 'Build without Emscripten' CI job and mirrored into vite.config.ts build.chunkSizeWarningLimit. Sizes are raw (un-gzipped) bytes of build/assets/*.js; 1 kB = 1000 bytes like Vite's reporter. Raise a number only with a reason in the PR; lower it whenever a phase earns the room.
entryNote: Ceiling = the entry as measured after #485 C (1,354,581 B) rounded up to the next kB. It sits above the 1,343,000 B that A+B reached because the precompiled validators (src/formats/*.validate.js, ~185 kB minified) replaced Ajv (~181 kB with the schema JSON) but stay on the boot path: registry.ts validates the bundled maps at import and ReachStreamer imports reachValidator. gzip still falls (422 -> 390 kB). Moving that validation off the boot path needs files outside #485's scope; it is worth ~237 kB raw / ~22 kB gzip. Tighten entryMaxBytes toward entryTargetBytes when it lands.
totalJsNote: Issue #485 asks for <= 3.5 MB raw. After C it is 3,512,137 B: 12 kB over, for the same reason as entryNote. The ceiling is today's number rounded up; the gap to the target is printed on every run.
